name: OCD

dims.source: Photo-measured bare enclosure (references/fulltone-ocd_measurements.md): W 302px/D 563px on the orthographic topdown at D=4.53in (115mm staging, data/spec_sheets_staging.json; retailer 4.5in corroborates); bare H 228px at 164px/in from both side views. Published 2.5 x 4.5 x 2.1in is overall (height includes knobs: measured knob tops give ~2.0in overall) — spec h is bare enclosure per spec-schema.

enclosure.notes: Custom cream box, flat deck (no slope) — measured dims override any preset. Colour sampled from lit non-specular patches (front #e0d8c3, topdown #d8d2b1).

knobs.note: Photo-derived in two views (topdown + front, symmetrised; measurements file). Black fluted knob 0.75in dia (mxr body diaScale 0.82). Rotation arrows are in the decal, so no tickRing. Pointer at 12 o'clock in the front reference.
Photo-derived: DRIVE right knob, same row as VOLUME.
Photo-derived: TONE centre knob below the LED.

led.note: Blue LED between VOLUME/DRIVE below the HP/LP toggle (blue-mask centroid in topdown + front). Lit in both lit references; hero starts ON. parts.js led() is red — the hero page re-colours it blue locally.

footswitch.note: Round chrome 3PDT stomp centred below the OCD wordmark (front washer centre + topdown, ±0.05in).

jacks.note: INPUT on the right wall, centred along z (V2 trait; V1.7 sat toward the front). Bore centroid in side-input view. Right=INPUT confirmed by wall print.
OUTPUT on the left wall, centred along z (side-output view).

labels.note: Above the VOLUME knob at the back edge (front + topdown). Case as printed.
Above the HP/LP toggle (toggle at z -1.70, hero-page staged; parts.js has no toggle builder).
Below-left of the toggle, left of the LED (front view).
Right of the TONE knob (front + topdown).

notes: Fulltone OCD V2 hero (2017 final version — see references/fulltone-ocd_measurements.md for V1.7-vs-V2 evidence: Built in the USA print + side jacks centred at z=0). Flat cream box; all deck parts seat via surfaceAt() (flat deck h=1.39) — no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. Top print split: Volume/Drive/Tone/HP/LP are vector labels; knob arrows, OCD wordmark, Fulltone script and Built in the USA are canvas-drawn in textures/fulltone-ocd-decal.png (custom letterforms). NOT in spec (no shared-library support; hero page stages them locally, ProCo precedent): HP/LP mini-toggle at (0,-1.70) bat toward back=HP, 9-18VDC side power jack on the left wall at (z +0.85, y 0.44), four side thumbscrews (z ±1.74, y 0.26, provisional), front-wall OCD/Fulltone print and side-wall Input/Output/9-18VDC print. Shared-library needs are listed in the build report — parts.js was not edited.
